Tercera competencia Nacional de El Salvador.
Los ganadores salvadoreños seran reconocidos como Campeones Nacionales Salvadoreños del año 2023

Third Salvadoran National Competition.
The salvadoran winners will be recognized as 2023's Salvadoran National Champions.

items.information:
All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. 
All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events.

Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

items.name: Back in Mauritius 2023
items.information:
Welcome!

This will be the fourth official competition held in Mauritius...

I, the delegate, is coming as a tourist and wanted to give others the oportunity to take part in speedcubing...

I hope to meet many enthusiastic competitiors and we'll have a great time...

We will begin from 5pm onwards...

items.name: Panama Nationals 2023

venue.name: Academia Interamericana de Panamá
venue.address: Costa del Este, Panama City, Panama 50764-057

items.information:
**Español**
* Primeras Nacionales realizadas en la Ciudad de Panamá
* Ven y disfruta del evento más grande realizado en el pais, con 15 categorías en tres días de competencia
* Los resultados preliminares y los clasificados a rondas posteriores se podrán ver en tiempo real en WCA Live

**English**
* First Nationals held in Panama City
* Come and enjoy the largest event held in the country, with 15 categories in three days of competition
* Preliminary results and qualifiers for later rounds can be viewed in real time on WCA Live
